content: The paper proposes a new method for simultaneously selecting important longitudinal (functional) features and performing classification with categorical outcomes, using an optimization framework that combines logistic loss with functional principal components. An adaptive Dual Augmented Lagrangian algorithm exploits sparsity for efficient computation in high-dimensional settings, and simulations plus a real study on chronic diseases demonstrate its effectiveness.
